text:
zoe (People Ops): Dropping a super-compact manager kit for Q-cycle: two 2-line manager comments (praise + redirect), four curated self-review prompts, a 30/60 check-in sentence, and two fresh OKR templates. Copy/paste friendly.

rahul (Eng Manager): exactly what I need. show the redirect for scope issues but keep it constructive.

zoe (People Ops): REDIRECT (2 lines)
- \"[Name], your execution is solid, but the last two initiatives grew beyond the original scope and impacted delivery.
- For the next project, please share a 3-point scope agreement (must-have, nice-to-have, out-of-scope) before code starts; well review it in kickoff to avoid surprises.

zoe (People Ops): PRAISE (2 lines)
- \"[Name] delivered a key piece of [project] that improved [metric].
- Appreciate the clear implementation and cross-team follow-throughgreat example of ownership.

marta (Product): love the scope phrasing. can you add a short public shout we can drop in the weekly digest?

zoe (People Ops): PUBLIC SHOUT (one line)
- \"Shoutout to [Name] for shipping [outcome] that improved [metric] by [X%]  thanks for moving this across teams! :tada:
\\
zoe (People Ops): SELF-REVIEW PROMPTS (one-liners to paste)
1) \"Biggest contribution this cycle and the measurable outcome (numbers or examples).\"
2) \"One tradeoff you made; what happened and what would you do differently?\"
3) \"Where do you want more ownership or stretch next cycle? Name one concrete goal.\"
4) \"Feedback for your manager: one thing to start, stop, continue.\"
\nrahul (Eng Manager): any short check-in sentence we can paste when we set expectations?

zoe (People Ops): 30/60 CHECK-IN LINE
- \"Well try this change for 30 days with a check-in at 2 weeks and a reassessment at 60 days.
\\
marta (Product): send a compact OKR we can reuse for infra or perf work.

zoe (People Ops): OKR A (performance)
- \"Objective: Make inference faster for common workloads. KR1: Lower p95 latency for 256-token requests from 220ms to 140ms. KR2: Reduce cost-per-inference by 10% via batching and cache hit improvements.

zoe (People Ops): OKR B (onboarding)
- \"Objective: Accelerate new hire ramp. KR1: Decrease median time-to-first-meaningful-PR from 18d to 9d. KR2: Publish 6 starter tasks and match every new hire with a buddy within 3 days.

interview-bot: Reminder: Panel feedback due in 48 hours. Use /panel-submit.

rahul (Eng Manager): perfect, thanks. can you add a 1-line interviewer micro-template for quick pass/follow decisions?

zoe (People Ops): INTERVIEWER ONE-LINER
- PASS: \"Strong technical chops and ownership examples; recommend hire at this level.\"

zoe (People Ops): If you want role-level variants (IC2/IC3/Senior/Staff) I can draft those and post in the People Ops doc. React :doc: if you want Staff-first.

rahul (Eng Manager): will do. thanks!
